subject: Proposed Ballot Overrides and Debt Exclusion
overview: The body met with Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn to discuss three upcoming ballot questions regarding funding for city infrastructure and school operations. The Mayor detailed the specific needs addressed by each proposal and responded to opposition from fire union leadership.

items.title: Introductions and opening remarks
items.summary: The hosts and Mayor Lungo-Koehn opened the session with introductions and personal updates.

items.title: Question 7: DPW and school operations override
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn outlined Question 7, a $3.5 million override to fund a dedicated DPW street repair crew and maintain existing school staffing levels and technology.

items.title: Question 8: School scheduling override
items.summary: The Mayor explained Question 8, a $4 million override intended to fund negotiations for improved school scheduling and increased student instructional time.

items.title: Question 6: Fire headquarters debt exclusion
items.summary: Discussion turned to Question 6, a debt exclusion for a new fire headquarters, where the Mayor countered claims that firefighters were not consulted during the design process.

items.title: Fire department accountability and culture
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn addressed personnel management challenges within the Fire Department, specifically regarding excessive sick time usage and the need for cultural reform.
